outcome: Need for red blood cell transfusion
Severe bleeding not requiring blood transfusion
cohort: Women who underwent elective cesarean section at term (37(+0/7)-41 + (6/7) weeks of gestations) between January 1, 2012 and May 31, 2019
finding: Preoperative mild thrombocytopenia was independently associated with blood transfusion (adjusted OR 2.34, 95% CI 1.10-4.96, p = 0.03).
mod_finding: Elective CS was performed in all participants.
